description: Returns a Mobiscroll Connect data model: the JSON shape of an event, calendar, recurrence rule, conference data, events page, connection status, token response or webhook delivery, with field types, which fields are read-only or write-only, and per-provider differences. Call without name to list the models. For the SDK class of a model in one language use getConnectSdkMethod (types).

name.description: Model name, e.g. "CalendarEvent". Omit to list every model.

name: getConnectModel
title: Get Connect Data Model
